title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in chat, or tap More info and paste the request in chat, for a deeper dive.

items.headline_md: Update: Saudi Arabia vows a 'serious' response as Houthi strikes keep hitting, and a slew of countries warn against travel
items.summary_md: Riyadh airport stayed shut after Saturday's strike killed 12 and injured 300+, and the US, UK, Australia, Japan and others now advise against travel to the kingdom.

items.headline_md: Update: Trump declares an 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine, but Kyiv reports new attacks on its energy sites
items.summary_md: Trump gave no details; Zelensky says Ukraine will honor it if Russia does, while the Kremlin rejected his 60-day truce offer.

items.headline_md: At least 139 migrants, including 15 children, die after a boat capsizes off Djibouti
items.summary_md: The boat was carrying 305 people toward Yemen; about 82 were rescued and dozens are still missing, the UN migration agency says.

items.headline_md: Poland detains a man suspected of plotting to assassinate PM Donald Tusk
items.summary_md: Police had received credible information about planned attacks on Tusk and his defence minister, and officials called the threat "deadly serious."

items.headline_md: A 14-year-old is arrested after a principal and a teacher are shot at a French middle school
items.summary_md: The shooting happened Monday morning in Aubagne; no children were hurt and the injuries aren't life-threatening.

items.headline_md: Hurricane Simon pounds Mexico's Pacific coast near Puerto Vallarta
items.summary_md: The storm hugged the coast as a Category 3 on Sunday, with its worst wind and rain expected overnight into Monday morning.

items.headline_md: A federal judge orders the Trump administration to stop airing taxpayer-funded TV ads featuring the president
items.summary_md: The order also blocks DHS from spending more of the $20M ad budget, about $19M of which is already spent.

items.headline_md: Americans Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford win the Nobel prize in economics
items.summary_md: They were honored for work underpinning the models central banks use to smooth out booms and busts, and will split a 12 million kronor ($1.2M) prize.

items.headline_md: BBC Panorama finds Deloitte helped falsify documents that hid Roman Abramovich's wealth from tax
items.summary_md: Accounts signed off in Cyprus made superyachts, mansions and jets worth $672M vanish from his company books.

items.headline_md: The EU will cap imports of Chinese hybrid cars at 350,000 a year
items.summary_md: Brussels is using WTO rules to impose the quota quickly, which would roughly halve China's share of that market to 3%.

items.headline_md: India's inflation jumps to 5.54% in September, a 22-month high
items.summary_md: It beat the 5.40% forecast and marks 11 straight months of increases, raising the odds of another rate hike.

items.headline_md: China is importing record amounts of gold
items.summary_md: The central bank bought about 23 tonnes in September, its biggest month in almost three years and its 23rd straight month of buying.

items.headline_md: Stellantis' CEO urges Europe to reward carmakers that build locally as Chinese rivals gain ground
items.summary_md: Antonio Filosa spoke ahead of the Paris Motor Show amid falling sales.

items.headline_md: Fingersoft is shutting down Lego Hill Climb Adventures but keeping all its staff
items.summary_md: In-app purchases stop Oct 23 and the game leaves app stores in December, though existing players keep access into 2027.

items.headline_md: Devsisters is making a CookieRun feature film with Big Shot Pictures, aimed at 2029
items.summary_md: The mobile franchise has drawn more than 350M players and over $1B in lifetime revenue.

items.headline_md: Roblox brings the Audioscape team in-house to build AI audio tools for creators
items.summary_md: Audioscape's tech finds sounds by how they sound and includes an AI audio agent for sound design and mixing.

items.headline_md: Steam sets a new concurrent-user record of more than 43 million
items.summary_md: More than 14M were in-game at once, also a record; it's Steam's second record this year after 42M in January.

items.headline_md: Nintendo says it has "no plans to ditch physical games"
items.summary_md: Latin America chief Bill van Zyll said Switch 2 supports both formats, after Sony said PlayStation will go discless by 2028.

items.headline_md: Gears of War: E-Day's server crashes and login problems were caused by DDoS attacks
items.summary_md: The Coalition says it's still monitoring and mitigating the attacks.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from the r/decomps general Wii U lifter. This morning's GitHub and web searches turned up only other early Wii U projects (for example a new Captain Toad recomp prototype for Android that isn't playable yet). Reddit blocked direct reads again today (403/429), so r/decomps and r/emulation weren't checked directly. No PS5 or Switch 2 breakthroughs today.

items.headline_md: Splinter Cell: Double Agent's original Xbox version gets an unofficial native PC port via static recompilation
items.summary_md: SCDA-XBERecomp needs your own game ISO and adds raw mouse input plus split-screen, LAN and online co-op.

items.headline_md: Dragon Quest IV (DS) hits 1.0 as a native Windows port built from its decompilation
items.summary_md: It joins both screens into one 16:9 HD picture and adds the mobile version's HD sound, restored party chat and gamepad support.

items.headline_md: Digimon World 2 (PS1) now runs natively on Windows and Linux with DW2-PC
items.summary_md: The port is built from the game's decompilation, adds widescreen and faster dungeon runs, and needs your own US disc image.

items.headline_md: Saturn emulator erings reaches 1.0 with GPU compute-shader rendering and resolution upscaling
items.summary_md: It also brings big performance gains and falls back to software rendering on GPUs that lack the needed features.

items.headline_md: ScummVM 2026.4.0 lands on the project's 25th anniversary with 194 newly supported games and 12 new engines
items.summary_md: Additions include FTL's 1987 dungeon crawler Dungeon Master, plus faster AdLib sound and fixes across 17 engines.

items.headline_md: The Super Mario Kart Deluxe SNES ROM hack is set to release on Dec 25, 2026
items.summary_md: It adds new characters, items and courses without overwriting the original game's content.

items.headline_md: Update: Sunday estimates for Oct 9-11 have Other Mommy at $27.5M, ahead of Verity ($11.5M), Resident Evil ($8.4M), Heart of the Beast ($7.1M) and The Social Reckoning ($5.5M)
items.summary_md: The weekend totaled about $85.2M domestic, down 15.6% from last weekend but up 18.5% from the same weekend in 2025.

items.headline_md: Other Mommy is a clear money-maker despite an 18% Rotten Tomatoes score and a D+ CinemaScore
items.summary_md: It cost about $19M and already stands at $45.2M worldwide after #1 openings in most foreign markets.

items.headline_md: Tom Cruise's Digger could lose $245M after dropping about 60% in its second weekend
items.summary_md: It has grossed around $35M worldwide against an estimated $280M to make and market.

items.headline_md: Self-distributed Gaza documentary NAZA passes $500K as it expands to 30 cities
items.summary_md: The Venice special jury prize winner has no distributor and has drawn protests.

items.headline_md: Update: Street Fighter opens Friday (Oct 16), and Box Office Theory's latest forecast is $25M-$35M
items.summary_md: That's a bit below Boxoffice Pro's earlier $30M-$40M range.

items.headline_md: A new trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero, the sequel to Godzilla Minus One, dropped at New York Comic Con
items.summary_md: It came alongside the full trailer for Prime Video's Blade Runner 2099 series.

items.headline_md: Microsoft president Brad Smith says AI is less regulated than milk and calls for global safety rules
items.summary_md: He wants a legal duty to tell victims when a rogue AI agent breaches them, and rules on when outside evaluators must sign off.

items.headline_md: The IMF's Georgieva says AI is hitting jobs like a "slow-moving tsunami," with young graduates most exposed
items.summary_md: A World Bank jobs council is urging crisis-era employment support measures.

items.headline_md: The CEOs of Intel and Broadcom warn that access to capital could become AI's biggest bottleneck
items.summary_md: Broadcom's Hock Tan said financing may matter more than chip, memory or power shortages.

items.headline_md: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew expects AI-driven scientific breakthroughs within two to three years
items.summary_md: He named physics, biotech, chemistry and materials science, and said autonomous systems will need stronger safeguards.

items.headline_md: Silicon Valley leaders are adopting Trump's 'super intelligence' rebrand of AI
items.summary_md: The Verge says Musk, Benioff, Huang and now Nadella have gone along with it.

sections.title: Tech, app stores & ads
sections.body_md: No major app-store, ad-monetization or design-tool changes turned up in the last 24 hours.

items.headline_md: Apple's HomeView smart-home hub will reportedly be announced Tuesday and ship in mid-November
items.summary_md: Bloomberg's Gurman says it has an A18 chip, a floating display on a speaker base, and comes in four colors.

items.headline_md: The OLED iPad mini may cost about $799, roughly $200 more than today's model
items.summary_md: That would price it above the 11-inch iPad Air, according to Gurman.

items.headline_md: Flock refused an Illinois college's request to remove its cameras, then uncovered them after the school covered them
items.summary_md: Elgin Community College tried to cancel its contract with the surveillance company.

items.headline_md: US limits on Chinese drones are driving up costs for cash-strapped police departments
items.summary_md: Many forces rely on cheap, high-quality Chinese drones for jobs like SWAT standoffs.

items.headline_md: NASA has posted more than 800GB of Artemis II images, audio and video online
items.summary_md: It gives an unusually detailed look inside the crewed lunar mission.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: US markets are open today; bank earnings start Tuesday.

items.headline_md: US stock futures are slightly higher: Dow +0.22% to 52,038, S&P 500 +0.25% to 7,879.75, Nasdaq +0.12% to 31,144.75
items.summary_md: Quoted at 4:25 AM ET (1:25 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: Oil reversed early losses: Brent rose 0.92% to $105.68 and WTI 0.95% to $92.72
items.summary_md: Prices had fallen about 1.5% earlier on Trump's 'energy ceasefire' before doubts about the supply boost set in (CNBC report at 4:37 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: Bitcoin is about $83,257 (+0.17% in 24 hours) and ether about $2,541 (+1.44%)
items.summary_md: Quoted at 5:09 AM AZ.

items.headline_md: Phoenix, AZ: Partly sunny with a 50% chance of showers and storms, high near 81°F; tonight storms likely (70%), low around 66°F
items.summary_md: Rain under a tenth of an inch, with south winds gusting to 25 mph; no active alerts.

items.headline_md: Show Low, AZ: Partly sunny and windy with a 30% chance of showers and storms, high near 62°F; tonight storms likely (60%), low around 49°F
items.summary_md: South winds of 22-26 mph gusting to 37 mph; no active alerts.

items.headline_md: Snowflake, AZ: Sunny and windy, high near 64°F, a slight chance of storms 11 AM-5 PM; tonight low around 49°F with a 30% chance of showers after 11 PM
items.summary_md: South winds of 17-28 mph gusting to 40 mph; no active alerts.

items.summary_md: A ground-level look at farm-state voters squeezed from all sides weeks before the midterms.
